purpose: Make every empirical source snapshot reproducible from retained raw bytes through normalized series to retained scientific artifacts without relying on a later live refetch.

ECB.policy: Public ESCB statistics may be reused free of charge with source attribution; revisions and updates may change published values.

BIS.policy: BIS statistics may be reproduced subject to the BIS permitted-use conditions and source attribution.

release_rule: A release may claim exact source-vintage reproducibility only when every source used by a retained scientific result has repository-retained raw bytes whose SHA-256 matches its manifest and every normalized derivative has a recorded SHA-256 and transformation provenance.
legacy_rule: A historical manifest that contains hashes but not the hashed raw payloads is retained as evidence of what was fetched, but is classified HASH_ONLY_LEGACY and must not be represented as exactly reproducible from that release.
